mapper.select: SELECT s.*, e.name as elementName, e.weight as elementWeight FROM EVALUATION_SCORE s JOIN EVALUATION_ELEMENT e ON s.element_id = e.id WHERE s.mapping_id = #{mappingId} ORDER BY s.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVALUATION_SCORE (mapping_id, element_id, score, comment) VALUES (#{mappingId}, #{elementId}, #{score}, #{comment})
